facts.summary: A defective phone was purchased for personal use. The complainant seeks a refund and compensation after the seller's grievance officer denied a refund.

eligibility.basis: Section 2(7): commercial/resale excluded; self-employment livelihood exception included. Purpose requires factual review.

limitation.basis: Section 69: two calendar years from stated cause of action. Delay condonation requires sufficient cause; recurring causes and date computation need advocate review.

claimA.basis: Consideration actually paid; primary jurisdiction basis.

claimB.basis: Comparison only: paid plus requested compensation. Interest omitted because no rate or period was supplied. This is not the governing jurisdiction test.

forum.basis: 2021 jurisdiction rules, effective 30 December 2021. District <= 50 lakh; State <= 2 crore; National above.

alternateForum.basis: Non-primary guide comparison; excludes unspecified interest.

fee.basis: INR; above 20–50 lakh a reported 500/1000 conflict requires registry confirmation. Higher bands use published fee schedule; confirm before filing.

territory.value: Where the complainant resides or personally works for gain; confirm the relevant commission.

value: Identity and address proof (submit only to the appropriate authority)
checklist.basis: Practical category checklist; commission may require more.

orders.summary: Mobile return-policy complaint dismissed for pecuniary jurisdiction, without a merits finding.
Wrong item delivered. Consumer relief upheld on seller appeal: product delivery plus compensation and litigation costs. Legal-aid penalty excluded.
Old damaged laptop delivered; final order directs payment of the agreed decretal sum. Components follow the stated refund and compensation; no separate cost inferred.
Territorial-jurisdiction dismissal set aside and complaint remanded. No final substantive award.

stats.note: Descriptive sample only. Missing values are excluded, never treated as zero. Interest excluded. Not a prediction.

hurts: lack of clear communication with the seller
verdict.nextStepReason: The complainant has already escalated the issue to the grievance officer and been denied a refund. The next step would be to file a complaint with the National Consumer Helpline (NCH) or the appropriate consumer commission.
verdict.nchDraft: To, the National Consumer Helpline, I, {complainant name}, purchased a {product name} from {seller name} on {date of purchase} for personal use. The product was defective. I have already contacted the seller's grievance officer, who denied my refund request. I am seeking a refund of {amount paid} and compensation of {compensation sought}. I have attached the following documents: invoice, delivery confirmation, and photos of the defective product.
caveats: ensure all evidence is attached and documentation is complete
be prepared to provide additional information or clarification as needed
review and understand the consumer protection laws and regulations

warnings: Fewer than three live orders were verified. Using only reviewed, category-matched seed orders where available; otherwise statistics remain insufficient.
